# Vendored — do not edit by hand

This directory is a verbatim mirror of the `plugins/claude-code` subdirectory of
[jgraph/drawio-mcp](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-mcp), re-synced by
`scripts/sync-drawio.sh`. Local edits here are overwritten on the next sync —
send fixes upstream instead.

| field         | value                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| source        | https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-mcp/tree/662417735af194d750bda1cdf10cc374df6577a9/plugins/claude-code |
| pinned commit | `662417735af194d750bda1cdf10cc374df6577a9`                                                             |
| requested ref | `main`                                                                                                 |

## Update

```bash
scripts/sync-drawio.sh            # latest upstream main
scripts/sync-drawio.sh <ref>     # a tag or commit sha
make validate                    # confirm the marketplace still validates
```

Review the resulting diff before committing, then `make release`.
